observations: Photo 0 shows a white digital piano with 88 keys, placed on a stand in what appears to be a storage or showroom area with other pianos wrapped in plastic in the background.
The piano has a slim design with built-in speakers on the left side, visible through a grille.

Photo 1 shows a close-up of the left side of the keyboard. White keys have musical note labels (C, D, E, etc.) and solfège (do, re, mi, etc.) printed on them. A red strip runs along the edge of the keys. Controls visible include a master volume slider, a metronome button, and a 'Rhythm/Piano Style' selector.

Photo 2 shows a close-up of the right side of the keyboard. Controls include 'Demo Song', 'Select', 'Tempo', 'Metronome/Rhythm', 'Pianist Style', and 'L Function' buttons. The keys also have solfège labels written in blue ink, some of which appear hand-written or taped on.
The brand name 'Yamaha' is not visible in any photo. The model name 'P-115' is not visible in any photo. The seller claims it is a Yamaha P-115, but no visual evidence confirms this.
The keys show some signs of wear: smudges, minor discoloration, and hand-written labels that may indicate previous use or customization.
